summary: Return a descriptor object or undefined using [[GetOwnProperty]], without primitive boxing.

target.notes: Dispatch through the ECMAScript object/internal-method runtime so Proxy traps, property descriptors, coercion, abrupt completion, and boolean-vs-throw behavior are preserved.

semantics.getter_invocation: described accessor getter is not invoked
semantics.proxy: getOwnPropertyDescriptor trap and invariants are observable

caveats: Do not replace this with C# reflection or ordinary property access when JavaScript object-model behavior is observable.

tests.name: getter is described, not invoked
tests.input: let n=0; const o={get x(){n++;return 1}}; const d=Reflect.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(o,'x'); console.log(typeof d.get,n);
